description: Modified version of my last Profit deck. It did okay at the last tournament against a copycat Chain of Command deck, but I picked up on a few changes that were needed.
cards: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed
The Force Is Strong With This One
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start 4': Profit/Destroy (You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed), JPAC (Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber), Tat JP (Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Light Special Edition page) and HFTMF; they count toward the 60. The line '(everything else varies)' is a comment and was dropped. The strategy says he usually starts Menace Fades, Staging Areas and Insurrection, or Ounee Ta in some matchups, so starting.effect is left empty.
